usage: jobpipe.py [-h] [--home HOME]
                  {init,migrate,mailbox,queue,apply-csv,submit-reviewed,invalidate-review,policy,status} ...

Jobops control plane for private queues and permit-gated ATS execution.

positional arguments:
  {init,migrate,mailbox,queue,apply-csv,submit-reviewed,invalidate-review,policy,status}
    init                Create Private Home and the Keychain permit key
    migrate             Import an ApplyPilot workflow privately
    mailbox             Configure or disable the optional read-only IMAP
                        verifier
    queue               Inspect the private CSV queue
    apply-csv           Run deterministic adapters from the private CSV queue
    submit-reviewed     Submit one persisted Review in a separate Gate B
                        invocation
    invalidate-review   Append a safe correction for a falsely detected Review
    policy              Show tier-specific material and permit policy
    status              Summarize the event ledger

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --home HOME           Override JOBOPS_HOME
